title: #236 Cook at Home
prompt: Some people would like to cook at home. Others prefer to eat at restaurants. Which one would you like? Support your answer with specific reasons.

promptSegments.text: Some people would like to cook at home.
Others prefer to eat at restaurants.
Support your answer with specific reasons.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Cooking at home gives people control over their food and is a good way to manage meals.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cooking at home gives people control over their food and is a good way to manage meals.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Eating at restaurants offers variety and is an easy way to enjoy different food choices.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Eating at restaurants offers variety and is an easy way to enjoy different food choices.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Cooking at home allows people to control the ingredients and taste of their meals, which is beneficial for health.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cooking at home allows people to control the ingredients and taste of their meals, which is beneficial for health.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Another advantage of cooking at home is that it saves money compared to eating out at a restaurant.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Another advantage of cooking at home is that it saves money compared to eating out at a restaurant.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Cooking at home allows individuals to control the ingredients and preparation of meals, which is beneficial for maintaining a healthy diet.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cooking at home allows individuals to control the ingredients and preparation of meals, which is beneficial for maintaining a healthy diet.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Restaurants offer a unique social experience and convenience, providing professional service and eliminating the need for cooking or cleanup.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Restaurants offer a unique social experience and convenience, providing professional service and eliminating the need for cooking or cleanup.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Cooking at home allows people to have complete control over the ingredients, enabling them to select fresh, organic items and avoid added sugars, which results in healthier food tailored to individual dietary needs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cooking at home allows people to have complete control over the ingredients, enabling them to select fresh, organic items and avoid added sugars, which results in healthier food tailored to individual dietary needs.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Another major advantage of cooking at home is the financial benefit, as preparing meals is significantly cheaper than eating out at restaurants, saving a considerable amount of money monthly.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Another major advantage of cooking at home is the financial benefit, as preparing meals is significantly cheaper than eating out at restaurants, saving a considerable amount of money monthly.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: present a balanced argument on the preference between cooking at home and eating at restaurants, highlighting personal inclinations and supporting reasons
outline: body1: personal preference for cooking at home and reasons
body2: advantages of eating at restaurants
keyArguments: Cooking at home allows for healthier and customizable meals using fresh ingredients.
Eating at restaurants offers a variety of cuisines and dining experiences, but it's less frequent due to cost and convenience.
